goal: When required original-requirement fields are missing, MKT asks clarifying questions in the customer dialog and the customer can answer them with a structured follow-up without entering the developer shell
scenarios: a short customer message is missing actors or scenarios and MKT asks those questions in the customer dialog
the customer answers a structured follow-up for a named field
the original requirement stays untracked until the customer confirms
after confirm, the original requirement is tracked with source quotes
a follow-up that includes technical design is rejected
product questions from a developer Agent Channel still appear in the customer MKT dialog
the customer does not need the developer shell to answer
constraints: raw customer language stays separate from confirmed original requirements
live-model default extractor is out of scope
